The '''Vensor system''' was located in the [[Vensori sector/Legends|Vensori sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The ''[[Veil of Skynara]]'', a [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was built in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vensor system was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square P-8.<ref name="TEA" />
